name: Inferno
body:
School transmutation [fire]; Level druid 5, shaman 5

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one creature

Duration 1 round/2 levels

Saving Throw Fort negates and Reflex partial; see text; Spell Resistance yes

You designate a creature and it bursts into flame taking 1d6 fire damage per 2 caster levels unless it succeeds on a Fortitude save. Each round thereafter the target must make a Reflex save or take 1d6 less fire damage than the previous round. For example, if the first round dealt 4d6 fire damage, the second round would deal 3d6 fire damage. A successful save, Fortitude or Reflex, halves the damage taken in the current round and ends the effect. Taking a full action to roll on the ground grants a +2 circumstance bonus to the Reflex save that turn.

Leaping into enough water to submerse the target or magically putting out flames will douse the flames.
